description_en: Deletes an Express Connect instance, including the requester VPC and accepter VPC
description_zh: 删除高速通道实例，包含发起端和接收端
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-express-connect --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --router-interface-id ri-119mfjz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteExpressConnect

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Express Connect instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 高速通道所在的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect instance
parameters.name: router_interface_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to force delete associated routes.

true: Force deletes the routes.

false: Does not delete the routes
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制删除关联的路由条目。

true：强制删除。

false：不删除
parameters.name: force

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
parameters.name: client_token
